actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.projects.PlanningServices.turnOn#Sprints').parameters({rootWorkEffortId: ec.context.get('projectTabId') || rootWorkEffortId || workEffortId || ''}).call() || {} ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {on: true, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: out.message}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.projects.PlanningServices.get#SprintDetail').parameters({workEffortId: sprintWorkEffortId || ''}).call() || {} const detail = out.detail ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() || !detail ? {} : {summary: {workEffortId: detail.workEffortId, workEffortName: detail.workEffortName, doneCount: detail.doneCount, openCount: detail.openCount, completedText: detail.completedText, remainingText: detail.remainingText, carryOptions: detail.carryOptions, nextSprintId: detail.nextSprintId}})

render-mode.text: ${ec.l10n.localize('The Backlog opens in the browser app (the qvue render mode).')}
